text:
monica: Quick handoff — launching BriefCast webinar Tue 11am PT. Need X + LinkedIn cadence, creative crops, two seedlists (enterprise/platform), and routing. Who owns scheduling?
ryan: I’ll do scheduling. Times: primer 8:30am PT, main 10:50am PT, follow-up Wed 9am PT.
tara: I’ll draft 4 copy variants: tease, metric, ops-hook, enterprise CTA. Need exact metric phrasing from eng.
brad: Creative will export 1200x628 (X), 1080x1080 (alt), 1080x1350 (LI), and a 6-slide PDF. Will drop link when done.
monica: Metrics to call out: "approx 33% lower cost" and "2x throughput at comparable p99" — legal wants the word 'approx' included. @olivia can you review?
olivia: Happy to. Tag drafts with "needs:legal" and I’ll review by EOD Mon.
ryan: UTMs: utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_linkedin&utm_campaign=briefcast_aug2026&utm_content=postA I’ll append to short.link/bc.
tara: Draft snippets: 
- Tease: "Free BriefCast demo Tue 11am PT. Register short.link/bc"
- Metric: "Approx 2x throughput at comparable p99; ~33% lower inference cost. Live demo Tue 11am PT."
- Ops-hook: "How we hit p99 with predictable cost. Join our live playbook."
- Enterprise CTA: "Enterprise seats limited — demo Tue 11am PT. Request invite."
brad: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood/marketing/briefcast_assets_v1.zip (includes alt-text).
monica: SDR routing: @sdr-bot please route registrants where utm_campaign=briefcast_aug2026 -> queue:webinar-social, tag:briefcast_aug2026, owner_rotation:enterprise-first. Also if seed=enterprise -> queue:webinar-enterprise.
sdr-bot: Routing set. Rule: utm_campaign=briefcast_aug2026 -> queue:webinar-social; if seed=enterprise -> queue:webinar-enterprise; tag:briefcast_aug2026; owner_rotation:enterprise-first.
tara: Growth asked for $1k paid. Recommend $700 on metric post (variantB) and $300 on Wed follow-up.
ryan: I’ll schedule drafts by Mon 4pm PT and flag needs:legal. Setting up A/B for metric post: variantA=benefit-first, variantB=metric-first.
monica: Add variant tracking via param ?variant=A or B and capture in registration payload. SDRs need variant in the assignment note.
sdr-bot: Variant param added to registration. Follow-up template created and includes variant + seedlist fields.
monica: Thanks team  sync Mon 4:30pm PT to confirm legal + paid creative. :rocket:
